fields.description: Shows Home, Selling, Buying, Stock, Accounting, CRM, Distributor 360, and HR (kept lower, for attendance). Hides Manufacturing, Projects, Assets, Quality, Support, Website, Tools, Build, Integrations, ERPNext Settings, Subcontracting, and Loan or Payroll extras. Untick this to put the full desk back for everyone. Nothing is deleted.
fields.label: Melliflous Simple Mode

fields.options: System Manager and Administrator can also press Full desk on the navbar. That shows every module for them only, and leaves this switch on for the rest of the team. A hidden page can still be opened from its address.

fields.description: These users, and Administrator, may rename or delete Sales Invoices and Purchase Invoices. Saving this form gives them the Invoice Admin role. Add the desk user here. The email address alone does not grant access.
fields.label: Invoice Admin Users

fields.description: Leave this off. e-Invoice and e-Way Bill stay available from the buttons on a submitted Sales Invoice, and are not generated or cancelled automatically. Tick this only if automatic generation should be allowed again.
fields.label: Allow auto e-Invoice/e-Way Bill

fields.options: Generate e-Invoice and Generate e-Waybill stay on submitted Sales Invoices for an Invoice Admin or a System Manager. Other users do not see those buttons, and they cannot rename or delete an invoice.

fields.description: One row per company. The next Sales Invoice uses the next serial after the highest number already saved for that prefix, including drafts and cancelled invoices. Numbers stay in posting-date order.
fields.label: Sales Invoice series

fields.options:
Leave the prefix blank to keep using the Sales Invoice naming series. A prefix such as MIMT/26-27/ continues that bill book. If the old software stopped at 150, set the starting number to 151. The invoice number is the document name, so it is the number GST and e-invoice use. It can be at most 16 characters: letters, numbers, / and -.

A back-dated invoice takes a free number between the invoices dated before it and the invoices dated after it. Cancelled invoices keep their number (it cannot be reused) but do not set that date order. Drafts do.
